title: Portfolio Platform
shortDescription: A full-stack developer portfolio with dynamic content and a premium UI.
fullDescription: A production-ready portfolio platform built with a React frontend and Node.js API. It showcases projects, certificates, and professional experience with optimized performance, SEO-friendly routing, and a modular content architecture.
features: Optimized image gallery and lazy loading
architecture: Monorepo-style separation with a React SPA consuming a versioned Express REST API. MongoDB stores structured portfolio content; the frontend uses route-based code splitting and shared design tokens.
challenges: Designing a flexible schema for rich project case studies
Balancing SEO needs with a client-rendered SPA
Keeping API responses consistent across modules
learnings: Schema design upfront reduces refactor cost later
Consistent API response envelopes simplify frontend error handling
Featured sorting at the query layer keeps list views predictable

title: TaskFlow
shortDescription: A collaborative task manager with real-time updates and team workspaces.
fullDescription: TaskFlow is a team productivity application that supports project boards, assignees, due dates, and activity feeds. It emphasizes clarity, fast interactions, and reliable state synchronization across clients.
architecture: Next.js App Router for UI and API routes, PostgreSQL for relational task data, Prisma ORM for type-safe queries, and Socket.io for live board updates.
challenges: Handling concurrent edits on shared boards
learnings: Optimistic UI improves perceived performance for drag-and-drop
Event ordering matters for collaborative state
Typed data layers catch integration bugs early

title: QuickCrave - FOOD Delivery app
shortDescription: A real-time food delivery app featuring an AI Chatbot, live GPS tracking for riders via WebSockets, and a fast, responsive UI.
fullDescription: QuickCrave is a comprehensive food delivery platform featuring a real-time ordering system, live GPS tracking via WebSockets, and a conversational AI Chatbot powered by Dialogflow for an intuitive ordering experience. It utilizes an asynchronous architecture to support robust role-based functionality for Customers, Riders, and Admins.
features: Real-time live GPS tracking using WebSockets
Role-Based Access for Admins, Riders, and Customers
In-memory session cart management via Redis
architecture: FastAPI backend for high concurrency, utilizing motor for asynchronous MongoDB operations. WebSocket rooms group users by active orders, with Redis managing state and GPS tracking deduplication. The React frontend interacts seamlessly with the AI webhook and real-time sockets.
challenges: Securely linking external Dialogflow sessions to authenticated users
Preventing race conditions during order state transitions
learnings: Throttling and caching WebSocket payloads in Redis significantly saves bandwidth
Asynchronous database drivers are critical for non-blocking socket handling
In-memory session management creates seamless chatbot-to-database flows

title: WeatherLens
shortDescription: Location-aware weather dashboard with forecasts and interactive maps.
fullDescription: WeatherLens aggregates forecast data from external APIs into a clean dashboard with hourly and weekly views, saved locations, and map-based exploration.
architecture: Vue 3 SPA with composable data-fetching layers, cached API responses in memory, and Chart.js for visualization. External weather APIs are proxied to protect keys.
challenges: Normalizing data from multiple API response shapes
Managing rate limits on free-tier weather APIs
Rendering performant charts on mobile devices
learnings: Client-side caching reduces redundant API calls
Composable hooks keep weather logic reusable
Graceful degradation matters when third-party APIs fail
